# Kompany

> Kompany is an open-source autonomous AI company engine. A human founder sends a one-line natural-language directive; an AI CEO classifies it, creates a project, routes tasks to specialized agents that execute real work (research, build, publish) under per-task budget caps. Irreversible actions (deploys, payments, public posts) stop at approval gates until the founder approves. A persistent ledger records every decision, cost, and outcome.

Key facts:
- Install: `uvx kompany onboard --yes` (Python 3.11+, any supported LLM provider API key)
- Source: https://github.com/Fei2-Labs/Kompany (open source)
- Interfaces: CLI, REST API, MCP server, Python SDK, desktop app, 24/7 daemon
- Live production case: Nova (@prompt_nova on X), an AI voice run by Kompany operating a real business with a public daily ledger at https://clarezoe.github.io/swedexpress-ledger/
- Founder: Clare (@clarezoe on X)
